title: N-step-grid: services.yaml thermal selectors keep the off-grid (min, step) pairs #1679 removed from the config flow
claim: At 92d38ecb, 6 of 47 services.yaml number selectors (set_thermal_parameters: slab_thermal_mass, slab_heat_transfer, upper/lower_floor_thermal_mass, inter_zone_heat_transfer, window_area) have both their max and their documented example off their own min+k*step grid in HA's default slider mode (12 seams), the same (min, step) pairs the R9 D4-s2-05 fix took off the options flow; and config_flow._widen_to_fit moves a slider's grid base to a stored out-of-range value, putting the field's own default off grid on 28 of 28 slider fields with a constant default.
mechanism: The grid base of an HTML number input and ha-slider is min. #1679 set step "any" on box fields in config_flow._number only; the service surface declares the same min/step pairs in YAML (0.02 + k*0.1 never reaches 0.8 or 5.0), and _widen_to_fit rewrites min to the stored value without snapping it to the field's step, so every nominal value of a widened slider becomes unreachable.

evidence.contention_note: two other D14 seats on the box; the count is contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: custom_components.heatpump_optimizer.config_flow:_widen_to_fit (and config_flow:_OPTION_FIELDS / _number delivered configs; services.yaml selectors as loaded)

perturbation.change: --perturb-svc: services.yaml number selectors read with step "any" (the #1679 fix carried to the service surface); --perturb-widen: _widen_to_fit snaps the widened min onto the field's own grid; --perturb-min: target-temperature slider min 15.2

null_control.value: box_pinned=0, seams_options=0 (49 box fields with step any are guarded)
null_control.note: the fixed surface reads zero, so the detector is not counting every selector

metric_definition: count of delivered number-selector configs whose max or numeric default/example is not min + k*step (|k-round(k)|>=1e-6), step != any
phenomenon_property: Every number selector the integration exposes (options flow, widened options field, service field) admits its own max and its own default/example as reachable values: either step is "any" or (value - min) is an integer multiple of step.
reproduction_steps: run the command; SEAM lines list services:set_thermal_parameters.* and widen:* seams

re-find at the R9 pre-fix tree: T=$(mktemp -d); git archive 26704a4e9f custom_components tests/hastub | tar -x -C $T; PYTHONPATH=$T/tests/hastub $HOME/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D14/s1/step_grid.py --tree $T -> box_pinned=43, seams_options=10 (the same slab/inter-zone/window pairs)
proposed_fix_scope: services.yaml set_thermal_parameters number selectors: mode box + step any (or min on the step grid); config_flow._widen_to_fit: when widening a slider, snap the new min down to old_min - ceil((old_min - v)/step)*step; barrier: this detector as a tests/config_flow_steps.py check over all three surfaces (sub-second)
